about: Igor Alexander Shapiro is an attorney at the Law Office of Igor A. Shapiro, which has its offices in Renton, Washington. He focuses his practice on personal injury and criminal defense cases, including auto and trucking accidents, traffic and speeding tickets, domestic violence, DUI defense, wrongful death, probation violations and protection orders.

Mr. Shapiro’s upbringing has given him an understanding of the challenges that minorities and the poor face when attempting to gain access to the legal system. His life's work is around becoming an advocate for those who are unable to speak up for themselves.

Profit maximization is the primary goal of many insurance firms. When you've been hurt, they know you don't know much about your legal rights, so they're trying to pay you as little as possible in compensation. For this reason, Mr. Shapiro continues to work in the personal injury field. He serves as a tenacious and zealous advocate for his clients’ rights.

Mr. Shapiro has a wealth of experience mediating and deliberating with insurance companies, and can use that knowledge to your advantage. He takes great delight in staying in close contact with clients throughout the entirety of their case and beyond. For his impeccable work in the legal profession, he has received a “Superb” rating on Avvo.

With a bachelor’s degree in interdisciplinary arts and sciences and political science, Mr. Shapiro went on to attend Willamette University College of Law to pursue his legal studies. After a year there, he moved to Seattle University School of Law to complete his Juris Doctor and graduated cum laude in 2019. In law school, he was the vice president of communications on the Alternative Dispute Resolution Board.

Mr. Shapiro is an active member of the Tacoma-Pierce County Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, The National Trial Lawyers, the Washington State Association for Justice and the King County Bar Association.
